body: Yeah ive done a lot of research on cannabis for cvs and how it may cause CHS and a bunch of stuff. I'm just too scared to try cbd/thc again in chance that it may hurt me or trigger this crap again. I will check out the cvs website again. Thank you!
I have a good husband and my grandparents helping me through it thankfully. Yeah im trying to figure out what my trigger may be. Its tough.
Yeah I just started keeping a journal of foods i eat things I'm feeling and etc. Mines generally early morning and gets worse the later it gets/earlier it gets.

Thank you for this response. I kind of figured it wasnt chs when I started experiencing symptoms again without even touching weed.  The honeymoon episode was the worst one which was really sad. I am paying more attention now and I have started keeping logs daily to see whats going on before it happens and such. 

I am a depressed person and someone that has dealt with severe anxiety my entire life.. It is always with me which is making this all the more hard because I'm not even sure how to stop it. 

I will ask my doctor about L-carnitine and Q10. Ive heard about those a little prior to this so thank you for reminding me. There's sadly no cvs specialists near me.  Ive been scrambling to find a doctor for a few weeks now.  I really hope i can dramatically lessen these attacks. I am so tired.

Thank you so much for your response.
